Title: Login with a valid account
Preconditions: User has a registered test account
Steps:
1. Open the app
2. Open Login
3. Enter the test email and password
4. Tap Sign in
Expected Result: The home screen is shown and the profile shows the user's name

Title: Login with a wrong password
Steps:
1. Open Login
2. Enter a registered email and a wrong password
3. Tap Sign in
Expected Result: An error message says the password is incorrect and the user stays on Login

Title: Sign in button is disabled with empty fields
Steps:
1. Open Login
2. Leave email and password empty
Expected Result: Sign in cannot be tapped (disabled) or shows required-field errors

Title: Search returns matching results
Steps:
1. Open Search
2. Type a word that exists in the catalog
3. Submit
Expected Result: Results are shown and each result contains the search word

Title: Search with no results
Steps:
1. Open Search
2. Type a random string like zzqxw
3. Submit
Expected Result: An empty-state message is shown instead of a blank list

Title: Change the app language
Steps:
1. Open Settings
2. Choose another language
3. Relaunch the app
Expected Result: All screens use the chosen language after relaunch
